bioAdditions: Johann Peter Grub married twice. The Reichenbach register shows him with a wife Gretha Catharina at the baptism of his daughter Anna Catharina in Aug 1684, and with Margretha Catharina at a daughter's baptism in 1687 (S1, S2). FamilySearch gives that first wife's death as before Oct 1694 and has her children born from 1679 to 1694, ending with Johann Nickel. On 19 Oct 1694 at Glan-Münchweiler he married Elisabetha Catharina Jung (c.1674-1734), daughter of Paul Jung, and had at least eight more children (S3). The 1694 marriage is the date the site gives for him, but the site attaches it to a single wife, 'Gretha Catharina Jung', which merges the two women (see H0078).
